body:
ok i genuinely can't stop thinking about this one 🤍

by 2012 the whole industry had basically agreed that the million-copy debut week was over — a very big artist shipping 300k copies out of the gate counted as a huge success.

then red walked in and sold 1.208 million copies in a single week. at $7.99. no bargain pricing, no 99-cent gimmick — people just bought it.

it was the biggest opening week for ANY album since eminem in 2002, roughly doubled the year's next-best debut, and made red her third album in a row to enter the charts at no. 1. it stayed the biggest week of her career until 1989 broke it two years later.

tag the friend who bought the physical cd the day it dropped — you know exactly who they are.
